planets.name: TOI-1782 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1782 with a 4.99-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1782 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1782. Its orbit and size follow Crossfield et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
